text:
Priya (PM): quick sync — sales flagged a large deal (AcmeCorp) asking for Private deployment with KMS/HSM + regional control by end of Q3. They say it's blocking $750k ACV. We need to decide sequencing: invest in Private features first or keep pushing Dedicated capacity improvements. thoughts? :thinking:

Samira (Sales): Acme is real — legal + infosec won't sign without VPC + HSM. they also asked for audit logs and non-shared control plane. they said Dedicated doesn’t meet their compliance bar.

Ben (Eng): important: Dedicated improvements (predictable throughput, autoscale tuning) are higher reuse for existing customers. Private requires infra changes (control plane separation, onboarding flow, KMS integration) and ~6-8 sprint effort across infra + infra-ops.

Alex (ML): from model-serving POV, Private + HSM impacts keys only. the runtime changes are minimal but deployment automation and e2e testing for on-prem/vpc is additional work.

Erin (Product Ops): propose we do a short RICE calc to make this concrete. I'll kick one off and we can sanity check.

Erin (Product Ops): RICE (quick estimates):
```
Private-first: Reach=2, Impact=7, Confidence=60, Effort=40 -> RICE = (2*7*0.6)/40 = 0.21
Dedicated-first: Reach=6, Impact=5, Confidence=70, Effort=20 -> RICE = (6*5*0.7)/20 = 1.05
```

Priya (PM): raw calc suggests Dedicated-first. but note AcmeCorp is a single large deal (high revenue, strategic). RICE's Reach underweights big enterprise deals.

Samira (Sales): adding context — if we win Acme, more regulated customers will follow; it acts as a beachhead. that changes expected Reach/Impact.

Ben (Eng): alternate approach: minimal Private MVP that covers KMS + audit logs + onboarding docs but still runs on our Hosted control plane (customer-managed keys). This narrows scope: estimated effort 15.

Alex (ML): technically feasible: support customer KMS + strict audit log forwarding + VPC peering for traffic flow. we’d still be Hosted control-plane but satisfy most compliance asks.

Priya (PM): ok proposal: two-track plan
- Track A (near-term): Private-MVP (hosted control plane + customer KMS + audit logs + VPC peering) — 6 weeks, gated by security review and pilot with Acme.
- Track B (mid-term): Full Private (dedicated control plane, on-prem bundle, HSM integration) — 3–4 months after Track A, prioritized if pilot signals more demand.

Erin (Product Ops): launch criteria for Track A:
- Security sign-off on KMS integration
- Automated onboarding playbook + one-click VPC peering doc
- Pilot with Acme for 30 days with no major incidents
- Telemetry: key ops metrics + audit log ingestion >= 95% success

Ben (Eng): devtask spike: 2-week spike to validate KMS providers (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure) + perf impact. Will scope in next sprint.

Samira (Sales): agree to run pilot and pause the demand push for Dedicated-only messaging. will ask Acme for pilot commitment and timeline.

Alex (ML): small note: implement KV cache and batching safety checks behind a flag for pilot so we can toggle perf/consistency tradeoffs quickly.

Priya (PM): decision summary: go with two-track, prioritize Private-MVP (hosted-control-plane KMS + audit logs) as customer-facing stop-gap, continue Dedicated infra improvements in parallel but lower priority. action owners: Ben -> KMS spike, Erin -> security gating checklist, Samira -> pilot commitment.

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled infra deploy window tonight 23:00 UTC; Ben, confirm if any KMS work needs to be blocked.

Ben (Eng): noted, will not deploy KMS changes tonight; spike is dev-only branch.

Priya (PM): thanks all. I'll write the brief for execs and include the RICE table + pilot gating criteria. anyone want edits before I post? :thumbsup:
